enchantments.tooltip: +16 Enhancement Bonus: +16 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.

Revel in Blood (Piercing): Your weapon hungers to let blood flow. Your attacks and offensive spells have a high chance to deal very strong Bane damage over time to creatures vulnerable to Bleeding. On weapon crit: 16d6 Piercing Damage.
Legendary Conditioning +20%: You have a +20% Legendary bonus to Maximum Hit Points.
Shield Bashing +25%: +25% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Unholy 7: On Hit: 7 to 42 Evil damage. Evil-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Good user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Petrification Immunity: This items gives immunity to Petrification.
